create_WebRequest: create a WebRequest dataclass instance to describe an HTTP GET request with method and target fields
build_WebRequest_body: build a WebRequest dataclass instance with an ArtifactContent body for POST request payload
test_WebRequest_fields: test the WebRequest dataclass fields including method, target, headers, and body attributes
